title: Design: an archived tier's Customers tab and Reactivate Tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data' and 'Customers — View'.
  • Have a new archived tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, with no customers.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Pick Archived in the Status filter.
  3. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  4. Click the Customers tab.
  5. Click Reactivate Tier.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 3:

  • Tier A's page opens with a gray Archived label beside the name.

Step 4:

  • The tab shows a people icon, tier A's name with "is archived", "Reactivate it to add customers." and a blue Reactivate Tier button, as in picture 9.21.

Step 5:

  • A message reads tier A's name "is reactivated. It's now the last tier, Tier" and a number.
  • The tab now reads "No customers on" tier A's name "yet", "Add customers to price their parts with this tier." and a blue Manage Customers button; the title shows the new number, as in picture 9.23.
